keys._comment: Ojiichan credential registry. Secret values live in Locke/Vaultwarden, not in sample env files.

vault._comment: Path format: {project}/{tenant}/{name}. Ojiichan supports OJIICHAN_VAULT_FOLDER and project-scoped runtime creds under ojiichan/projects/<service>/... selected by OJIICHAN_VAULT_PROJECT.
vault.ojiichan/bugsink-api-token: Bugsink API token for issue reads
vault.ojiichan/bugsink-host: Bugsink host when not derivable from DSN
vault.ojiichan/bugsink-project-id: Bugsink project id when not derivable from DSN
vault.ojiichan/sentry-auth-token: Sentry API token for issue resolution
vault.ojiichan/sentry-base-url: Sentry-compatible API base URL; defaults to https://sentry.io
vault.ojiichan/rustrak-base-url: Rustrak API base URL; defaults to https://ingest.rustrak.pseekoo.io (UI host is the same domain without the ingest. prefix)
vault.ojiichan/rustrak-project-id: Default Rustrak project id used when callers omit one
vault.ojiichan/scaleway/loki-url: Scaleway Cockpit logs data-source URL (scw cockpit data-source list -> type=logs 'url')
vault.ojiichan/scaleway/cockpit-token: Scaleway Cockpit token with query_logs scope (scw cockpit token create ... token-scopes.query_logs=true)
vault.ojiichan/elk/admin-url: obachan OpenSearch admin URL (seeded once; lets `ojiichan provision all` run with just --project)
vault.ojiichan/elk/admin-password: OpenSearch admin password (privileged; used only to create per-project access)
vault.ojiichan/rustrak/admin-url: Optional Rustrak admin API base URL for project creation
vault.ojiichan/elk/host: OpenSearch/ELK host or base URL (written by `ojiichan provision elk`)
vault.ojiichan/elk/username: Scoped writer username (written by `ojiichan provision elk`)
vault.ojiichan/elk/password: Scoped writer password (written by `ojiichan provision elk`)
vault.ojiichan/elk/index-prefix: Project index prefix (written by `ojiichan provision elk`)
vault.ojiichan/rustrak/api-token: Rustrak API token (written by `ojiichan provision rustrak`)
vault.ojiichan/otel/exporter-endpoint: OTLP exporter endpoint (written by `ojiichan provision otel`)
vault.ojiichan/otel/exporter-headers: OTLP exporter headers, may carry a bearer token (written by `ojiichan provision otel`)
vault.ojiichan/projects/<service>/elk/host: Project-scoped OpenSearch/ELK host written by `ojiichan provision elk --project <service>`

env._comment: Non-secret runtime options or explicit local overrides.
env.OJIICHAN_VAULT_FOLDER: Optional Vaultwarden folder prefix; defaults to ojiichan
env.OJIICHAN_VAULT_PROJECT: Optional service namespace; reads ojiichan/projects/<service>/... before shared paths
env.OJIICHAN_ISSUE_BACKEND: Project-declared issue backend: rustrak | sentry | bugsink. Bugsink resolve is not supported.
env.ELASTICSEARCH_CA_CERT: Path to a CA bundle (PEM) to trust for OpenSearch TLS; set to obachan's obachan-internal-ca so verification succeeds against the internal cluster instead of using --insecure
env.BUGSINK_TIMEOUT: Bugsink API timeout seconds; defaults to 10
env.SENTRY_TIMEOUT: Sentry API timeout seconds; defaults to 10
env.RUSTRAK_TIMEOUT: Rustrak API timeout seconds; defaults to 10
env.SCALEWAY_RESOURCE_TYPE: Loki resource_type label for the stream selector; defaults to serverless_function
env.SCALEWAY_TIMEOUT: Scaleway Loki query timeout seconds; defaults to 15
